name: multi-bespoke attach combining plays, practice, and dfs-salaries
description: Composes two or more bespoke-attach sources at differing grains in one query: plays (player_year aggregation), practice (player_week), and dfs-salaries (player_week). Coverage gap (c).
expected_query: with "t6bc078d7ecc6d4abd085922e02dd7761" as materialized (select COALESCE(ball_carrier_pid) as pid, SUM(rush_yards) as rush_yds_from_plays from "nfl_plays" where "play_type" in ('PASS', 'RUSH', 'KOFF', 'PUNT', 'FGXP', 'FREE') and "nfl_plays"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_plays"."season_year" in (2023) group by COALESCE(ball_carrier_pid)), "base_years" as (SELECT unnest(ARRAY[2023]) as year), "player_years" as (SELECT DISTINCT player.pid, base_years.year FROM player CROSS JOIN base_years), "t13f9bf4556d499997cf3acea4cc0b3d9" as (with "dfs_base" as (select "player_salaries"."pid", "player_salaries"."salary", "nfl_games"."season_year" as "year", "nfl_games"."week", "player_salaries"."source_id", "player_salaries"."source_contest_id", "player_salaries"."esbid" from "player_salaries" inner join "nfl_games" on "player_salaries"."esbid" = "nfl_games"."esbid" where "player_salaries"."source_id" in ('DRAFTKINGS') and "nfl_games"."nfl_week_id" in ('2023_REG_WEEK_1')), "dfs_ranked" as (select "dfs_base".*, dense_rank() over (partition by "source_id", "source_contest_id" order by "esbid") + dense_rank() over (partition by "source_id", "source_contest_id" order by "esbid" desc) - 1 as "slate_size" from "dfs_base") select distinct on ("dfs_ranked"."pid", "dfs_ranked"."year", "dfs_ranked"."week") "dfs_ranked"."pid", "dfs_ranked"."salary", "dfs_ranked"."year", "dfs_ranked"."week" from "dfs_ranked" order by "dfs_ranked"."pid" asc, "dfs_ranked"."year" asc, "dfs_ranked"."week" asc, "dfs_ranked"."slate_size" desc, "dfs_ranked"."source_contest_id" asc) select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, "t6bc078d7ecc6d4abd085922e02dd7761"."rush_yds_from_plays" AS "rush_yds_from_plays_0", "t0ffdb4d66181b3ca6e1508633a1071b5"."wednesday_practice_status" AS "player_practice_designation_w_0", "t13f9bf4556d499997cf3acea4cc0b3d9"."salary" AS "dfs_salary_0", "player"."primary_position" from "player" inner join "player_years" on "player_years"."pid" = "player"."pid" left join "t6bc078d7ecc6d4abd085922e02dd7761" on "t6bc078d7ecc6d4abd085922e02dd7761"."pid" = "player"."pid" left join "practice" as "t0ffdb4d66181b3ca6e1508633a1071b5" on "t0ffdb4d66181b3ca6e1508633a1071b5"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "t0ffdb4d66181b3ca6e1508633a1071b5"."nfl_week_id" in ('2023_REG_WEEK_1') left join "t13f9bf4556d499997cf3acea4cc0b3d9" on "t13f9bf4556d499997cf3acea4cc0b3d9"."pid" = "player"."pid" group by player.first_name, player.last_name, "t6bc078d7ecc6d4abd085922e02dd7761"."rush_yds_from_plays", "t0ffdb4d66181b3ca6e1508633a1071b5"."wednesday_practice_status", "t13f9bf4556d499997cf3acea4cc0b3d9"."salary", "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by "player"."pid" asc limit 500
